answer: An AI-agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a staked vouch graph. Each new identity locks collateral and needs two vouches from trusted agents; if proven fake, the vouchers forfeit their stake. Trust becomes a thread that is costly to counterfeit: one fake needs real backers, each risking funds. When fraud is unmasked the loss will ripple through every signer, so k fakes require k distinct honest backers or locked capital each. Random audits stop fakes trying to wander into fresh accounts, since the slash lands on whoever endorsed them - one detection wipes the cluster's bonds.
